The House Committee on Regulated Industries offers Bill 630 (COMMITTEE SUBSTITUTE) By: Representatives Wiedower of the following substitute to HB 630: 121st, Ridley of the 6th, Corbett of the 174th, Prince of the 132nd, Reeves of the 99th, and others
A BILL TO BE ENTITLED AN ACT
To amend Chapters 7A and 47 of Title 43 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, relating to practice of applied behavior analysis and used motor vehicle and used motor vehicle … accredited by the National Commission on for Certifying Agencies or the American National Standards Institute as identified by the board."
PART III SECTION 3-1.
All laws and parts of laws in conflict with this Act are repealed.
